cut_off.instructions: state has a short description and one screenshot of one screen of a web page. Is any text, button or image cut off at the left or right edge of the screenshot, or clipped inside its own box (for example a button label running out of its button)? Content cut by the top or bottom edge of the screenshot is not cut off: the page continues there when scrolling.

fixed_covers.instructions: Does a fixed element (the sticky header, a sticky table-of-contents bar, the bottom bar or the floating chat buttons) cover part of a button, card, form or text on the page, or does page content show through such an element?

overlap.instructions: Do two parts of the page layout overlap so that text or a control is hidden or hard to read? Do not count fixed elements, and do not count a menu, panel or dialog that the description says is open.

empty_control.instructions: Is there a button, pill or box with no visible label, or text with almost the same color as its background?

media_problem.instructions: Is an image, chart, video thumbnail or icon broken, missing, stretched, badly cropped or blurry?

spacing.instructions: Do elements touch each other, look misaligned with their neighbours, or have clearly uneven gaps?

defect_box.instructions: the most visible layout problem in the website screenshot: cut-off text, a covered button, an empty button, overlapping elements or a broken image

polish.instructions: How polished does this screen look for a professional education and training website?
criteria: Broken: the layout is clearly broken
Excellent: polished, comparable to a top publisher

readability.instructions: How easy is the main text on this screen to read on this device?
criteria: Hard to read: too small, low contrast or cramped
Very easy to read: comfortable size, spacing and contrast
